name: Employee Health Scheme
benefit: In-Patient Treatment: The Employee Health Scheme (EHS) aims to provide cashless hospitalization to eligible beneficiaries such as employees, pensioners, and their dependents. The scheme covers listed therapies for identified diseases, providing end-to-end cashless services until 10 days post-discharge, including coverage of complications up to 30 days post-discharge.
